_about: Inputs for tools/upgrade-calc.py: one measured dummy run per carry (DPS Test Dummy++, Stygian Dire preset, Stygian Start: the owner always uses it), the carry's stats at that run, and the gear from the latest HoYoLAB read. Fractions, not percents (0.466 = 46.6%). Team buffs are assumptions, stated as such.

carry.name: Skirk
carry._source: 22 Nov dummy stat sheet (ATK 2274, CRIT 66%/133%, Cryo 15%); base/pct/flat split from the 16 Nov HoYoLAB gear

team._assumed: pct: Noblesse Oblige +20% and Thrilling Tales +48% ATK, each up about half the time. dmg: Furina's Fanfare at Burst 4 averaging 60% of 300 points (0.13% per point).

talents._note: 16 Nov talents 6/7/6. Her Seven-Phase Flash hits are in the Elemental Skill table (Havoc: Warp, wiki 22 Nov), so Skill is the lever, as Game8's guide also says; share = part of her damage from those hits (assumed)

benchmarks._source: community calcs the owner found on Google, 22 Nov 2026: Genshin Scientist (KQM investment, C0 everyone), r/SkirkMains 'My Skirk Day 1 Calc' (meowtews, speculative day-1, 20s rotation), and a Reddit team-DPS table. Standard enemy, no zero-Energy start, so the owner's Stygian Dire dummy reads lower for the same team.

teams.team: Skirk / Furina / Escoffier / Shenhe (= Mona, Yelan, Citlali)
teams.by: Genshin Scientist, KQM; Skirk 73%, Escoffier 15%, Furina 9%

investment._by: Genshin Scientist, each against the C0 base team

weapons._by: r/SkirkMains day-1 calc, against Finale R5; The Black Sword not listed

carry.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
carry._source: CRIT and Anemo from the 22 Nov dummy sheet; EM 644 is the 16 Nov read at Lv 70 (the 22 Nov sheet does not show EM), so EM-based results are approximate

team._assumed: no team EM or DMG buffs counted (Sucrose's EM share is left out)

talents._note: 16 Nov talents 2/6/6; share = part of her damage from her Skill (assumed)

mizuki._gearNote: 16 Nov pieces were +12; main stats are counted at their +20 values

run._missing: only the team total (~25k) was reported; a run with the damage breakdown is needed

carry.name: Varesa
carry._source: CRIT from the owner's Google conversation (newer than 16 Nov); base derived from the 16 Nov sheet: ATK 1614 = base x 1.466 + 344 flat, so 866 (Widsith 510 + her own 356)

team._assumed: Iansan's flat ATK buff not modelled yet

talents._note: talents 8/6/7 per the owner; share = plunge (Normal Attack) part, assumed
